value.candidates: ={{ $json.candidates.map(c => ({ contactId: c.contactId, firstName: c.firstName, lastName: c.lastName, email: c.email, phone: c.phone, title: c.title })) }}

parameters.query:
update public.contacts
set interaction_notes = case
  when interaction_notes is not null and position($2 in interaction_notes) > 0 then interaction_notes
  else coalesce(interaction_notes || E'\n\n', '') || $2
end
where id = $1
returning id;

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { contactId: $json.id, matched: true, messageId: $('Split Attach List').item.json.messageId } };
return { json: { contactId: $('Split Attach List').item.json.contactId, matched: false, messageId: $('Split Attach List').item.json.messageId } };

parameters.query: update public.inbound_messages set matched_contact_ids = '{}' where id = $1 returning id;

with updated as (
  update public.inbound_messages
  set link_attempts = link_attempts + 1,
      last_link_attempt_at = now(),
      matched_contact_ids = $2::uuid[]
  where id = $1
  returning id, link_attempts
)
update public.inbound_messages i
set link_status = case
  when array_length($2::uuid[], 1) > 0 then 'linked'
  when u.link_attempts >= 50 then 'no_candidate_found'
  else i.link_status
end
from updated u
where i.id = u.id
returning i.id, i.link_status;

parameters.content:
## sub-link-transcript-to-contacts
Extracted shared logic, mirroring agent.mjs's own factoring exactly: linkTranscriptToContacts + recordLinkResult are used both by the first attribution attempt (processAudioMessage, right after transcribing) and every retry pass (relinkUnlinkedAudioMessages) -- "re-running this against a possibly-grown candidate list is exactly the right retry behavior" per the source comment. This sub-workflow is that shared unit: given {messageId, transcript, candidates}, it decides whether to run attribution at all, calls sub-attribute-voice-memo when there's something to reason about, attaches excerpts idempotently, and always ends in the same recordLinkResult write.

Called by pipeline-voice-transcription (Stage 3, first pass, right after Write Transcript) and pipeline-relink-unlinked-audio (Stage 0's retry sweep, completed alongside this build -- see that workflow's own updated sticky note).

Has Candidates? / Attribution Succeeded? / Has Attach Items? all branch BEFORE their respective fan-outs rather than relying on zero-item behavior after them -- a real, valid outcome (no candidates; the skill found nobody; nothing attributable) must still reach a write, and deriving that from an aggregate step fed by zero items risks the aggregate never running at all. Every branch stamps messageId (and contactId/excerpt for the attach fan-out) onto its own items explicitly rather than reaching back across a fan-out/collapse boundary via $('Node').item.

A genuine sub-attribute-voice-memo FAILURE (not 'found nobody', an actual validation/API/circuit-breaker failure) does no write at all (Attribution Succeeded? onFalse is a dead end) -- matches processAudioMessage exactly: link_attempts is never bumped for a failed call, so the row looks like 'never attempted' and stays eligible for claim_unlinked_audio_messages to pick up again, which is the pass that actually counts as an attempt.

Write Link Result's two feeder branches (No Attach Items, and Aggregate Matched Ids after the per-contact attach loop) produce the identically-shaped {matchedContactIds, messageId} so ONE shared Postgres node handles both -- matched_contact_ids is written unconditionally, link_status only advances to linked (any match) or no_candidate_found (link_attempts >= LINK_MAX_ATTEMPTS=50 with none), otherwise untouched, in one atomic two-CTE statement. The no-candidates case (Has Candidates? onFalse) is the one exception: it writes matched_contact_ids='{}' only, with no link_attempts bump at all -- matching linkTranscriptToContacts returning ranAttribution:false, which processAudioMessage never counts as a spent attempt.

Attach Excerpt To Contact's idempotency check (position(excerpt in interaction_notes) > 0 -> leave unchanged) is done IN SQL, atomically -- matches attachExcerpts' own it's-already-there-do-nothing behavior. Uses position(), not LIKE, since an excerpt containing a literal % or _ would otherwise act as a SQL wildcard.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 3). No credential of its own on the Anthropic side (lives in sub-run-skill via sub-attribute-voice-memo) -- the Postgres nodes here have no credential attached yet either, see n8n/README.md.
